run_AlphaFold3_model_inference: run the AlphaFold3 Model class forward pass on a data batch to get diffusion samples and confidence outputs
create_predicted_structure: create a predicted protein structure from model output results and a feature batch using get_predicted_structure
compute_inference_result: compute the full InferenceResult with pTM, ipTM, PAE metrics, and ranking scores from model output via get_inference_result
create_target_feat_embedding: create a target feature embedding with atom cross-attention conditioning for the Evoformer module
compute_ptm_iptm: compute pTM and ipTM confidence scores from PAE outputs using _compute_ptm with interface flag
